seed_generator.algorithm: python random.Random(f"{seed}:{label}").sample(range(2, max_seed), count + len(excluded)), excluded seeds dropped, first count kept; label is tpch or tpcds

text_normalisation.tpcds: dsqgen stdout from DSQGenBinary._extract_sql_from_output, CRLF and CR replaced by LF, multi-part a/b selected as BenchBox does
text_normalisation.tpcds_stream_template: statements of the last stream in the dsqgen stdout split on (?<=;)\n+(?=\S), stripped, joined with a blank line, newline normalised
text_normalisation.tpcds_stream_all: each statement of query_<n>.sql split as BenchBox does, newline normalised
text_normalisation.tpcds_explicit: dsqgen stdout for the template rewritten as DSQGenBinary.generate_with_parameters rewrites it, extracted and normalised as tpcds; t is the sha256 of the rewritten template text (UTF-8)

tpch.random_digest: sha256 over, for each query in order, '<query>\n<cleaned text>\n'

mechanism.summary: dsqgen has no option that takes parameter values. BenchBox copies the template into a scratch work directory, rewrites the copy's text, and runs dsqgen on the copy with the options of a seeded run and no -LOG.
mechanism.command: dsqgen -TEMPLATE <template> -DIALECT netezza -SCALE <sf> -RNGSEED <seed> -FILTER Y -VERBOSE N -INPUT q/templates.lst -DIRECTORY q
steps: Sub-SF1 template overrides (SUBSCALE_TEMPLATE_OVERRIDES, query93.tpl) are applied to the staged template before the rewrite.
Each key must match name_pattern, the form dsqgen -LOG writes (for example YEAR.01); NAME is group 1 and POSITION is int(group 2). The value is used as str(value).

Every [NAME.POSITION] in the template text is replaced by the value; when POSITION is 1 every [NAME] is replaced as well. Replacement is literal text, applied key by key in the order given, so a later key sees the output of earlier ones.
A key that matches nothing raises ValueError unless the template has a define NAME = statement, in which case the key is ignored.

define statements stay in the rewritten template and dsqgen still parses them; the substituted names no longer appear in brackets. Brackets that were not substituted ([_LIMITA], [_END], names absent from the parameter dict) are evaluated by dsqgen from -RNGSEED and -SCALE.
Queries 14, 23, 24 and 39 use query<N>.tpl for both a and b; the output is split on ';' and part 0 (a) or 1 (b) is kept.
The text is the dsqgen stdout up to the 'qgen2 Query Generator' or 'Copyright Transaction' banner.

equivalence.parameter_source: dsqgen -LOG values of template <n> at that rngseed and scale, stream 0
equivalence.round_trip: r is the text hash of the seeded dsqgen run at the same rngseed and scale

explicit_parameters.text_query_generate_with_parameters: benchbox/core/tpcds/queries.py TPCDSQueryManager.generate_with_parameters forwards to DSQGenBinary.generate_with_parameters with the default seed 1, so its output is the qualification-case mechanism at the scale factor passed

dialects.unsupported_dialect_behavior: DSQGenBinary._validate_dialect warns and falls back to netezza
dialects.reason: every call path in the repository reaches dsqgen with netezza; the other bundled dialect templates are never selected, so they are not captured

call_sites.role: the only place a single-query dsqgen command line takes -DIALECT
the only place a -STREAMS dsqgen command line takes -DIALECT; the parameter defaults to netezza
qualification calls omit dialect, so the netezza default applies
equivalence builder calls omit dialect, so the netezza default applies
throughput streams call generate_dsqgen_streams without dialect, so the netezza default applies
parameter binding calls omit dialect, so the netezza default applies
OBT parameter logging omits dialect, so the netezza default applies
parameter extraction omits dialect, so the netezza default applies
the benchmark passes src to dsqgen, and src is base_dialect or netezza
the only get_tpc_base_dialect definition; it returns netezza for every benchmark
base_dialect for platform query extraction comes from get_tpc_base_dialect
base_dialect for dry runs comes from get_tpc_base_dialect

dialects.public_api: TPCDS.get_queries and TPCDS.get_query forward a caller-supplied base_dialect to dsqgen; no call in the repository passes a string literal, only the get_tpc_base_dialect result or a forwarded parameter

nondeterministic_cases.finding: Repeated dsqgen runs in one mode return one text hash; the run that writes -LOG and the run that does not return different text for these cases, so the nondeterministic status in tpcds_single means the two invocation modes disagree. BenchBox DSQGenBinary.generate runs without -LOG and generate_parameter_log runs with it.

replay.rule: An entry is replayable when its bundles record a seed or query parameters. Entries that record neither are not replayable and are excluded from the retirement gate.
